blocks.text: Machine learning ke tareeqe batate hain ke systems data se kaise seekhte hain. Mukhtalif tareeqe mukhtalif masail ke liye munasib hain: kuch labelled data use karte, kuch nahi, aur kuch feedback aur tajurbe se seekhte hain (Fig 6.4). Sahi tareeqa chunna ahem hai, kyunke seekhne ka miyar is par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Labelled aur unlabelled data
blocks.text: Labelled data ke har hisse ke saath durust output hota hai (tasveer par 'apple' likha); unlabelled data mein aise jawab nahi hote.

blocks.caption: Machine learning ke tareeqe
rows: Labelled data se: har input ka durust output, model apna jawab us se milata hai. Bare, achhe miyar ke labelled datasets chahiye aur andaze (classification aur regression) ke liye use hota hai.
Spam ya nahi; billi ya kutta; normal ya ghair-normal scans; chehre aur awaz ki pehchan; dhoka-dahi ki pakar; imtihani nateeje ka andaza
Unlabelled data se: koi durust output nahi diya jata; milti julti cheezon ko groups (clusters) mein rakh kar chhupi banawat dhoondta hai.
Gahakon ki grouping; data clustering; data ki parakh
Insaan ki tarah aazma kar: agent mahol mein amal karta aur inaam ya saza pata hai, zyada se zyada inaam ka maqsad.
Robot ka maze seekhna; AlphaGo ka Go mein behtar hona; self-driving gari ke faisle; feedback se badalti recommendations

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Supervised (labelled): phalon ke teen khaake har aik label se jura, apple, banana aur grapes; har misal ka durust jawab. Unsupervised (unlabelled): nuqte jo teen rangeen clusters banate; jawab nahi diye jate aur system groups dhoondta. Reinforcement: agent ka dabba mahol ke dabbe ko amal bhejta, jo inaam ya saza wapas deta; aazma kar seekhta.
blocks.caption: Supervised, unsupervised aur reinforcement learning (Fig 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Supervised learning ko ustad ke jawab chahiye, unsupervised learning apne groups khud dhoondti, aur reinforcement learning apne amal ke nataij se seekhti hai.

blocks.title: Rule-based systems
blocks.text: Mashq rule-based learning ka bhi zikr karti hai jo chapter mein bayan nahi. Rule-based systems logon ke likhe if-then qawaid par chalte hain, 6.3 ki riwayati programming ki tarah, is liye woh khud data se naqsh nahi seekhte.

blocks.prompt: Har kaam ke liye kaun sa tareeqa? (a) Khareedari ki aadaton se gahakon ki grouping jab koi category na di gayi ho. (b) Pichhli farokht se gharon ki qeemat ka andaza. (c) Jeet par inaam de kar game khelne wala program sikhana.
blocks.explanation: (a) Unsupervised (clustering). (b) Supervised (pichhli qeematein labels hain; yeh regression hai). (c) Reinforcement (inaam aur saza).

items: Supervised: labelled data, andaze ke liye.
Reinforcement: inaam aur saza, aazma kar.
